core_claims: OS Terrain 50 is a bare-earth digital terrain model
it is intended for landscape visualisation and large-area analysis
the product is Open Data
grid and contour data are made from the same source data
tile supplies use 10km by 10km tiles identified by the southwest National Grid reference
grid points use regular 50m post spacing
standard contour polylines use 10m intervals
contours include mean high water mean low water and spot heights
formats include ASCII GML shapefile GeoPackage and MBTiles as applicable
the tiled full set contains 2858 tiles arranged in 55 folders
online download is available without registration
grid data has been verified at 4m RMSE
maintenance uses an integrated 3-to-5-year flying programme
terrain updates are synchronised with other product updates
national vector tiles use Web Mercator EPSG:3857
contour-line spot-height and land-water-boundary attributes are mapped at zoom levels 9 to 14
vector tiles are supplied nationally in a single MBTiles file
contours are supplied nationally in a single GeoPackage file
GeoPackage layers are spot_height land_water_boundary and contour_line
GeoPackage attribute names changed to user-friendly snake_case forms
XML metadata follows the GEMINI metadata standard and exists nationally and per tile
metadata identifies spatial representation tile reference elevation topic and British National Grid CRS
asc.aux.xml provides min max mean and standard-deviation statistics consistently across tiles
spot heights select the highest mass point in a closed contour remove equal-height points allow genuine depressions and round z to zero decimals
